chunks: As for what occurs in it from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from ʿAbdullāh ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād, who was known by the kunyah Abū Ismāʿīl.

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي الْبِلَادِ: A transmitter whose narrations in the book are being linked through a specified sanad/isnad.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an expression indicating the author’s reception and narration of the report.
key_terms.يُكَنَّى أَبَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ: He was known by the kunyah Abū Ismāʿīl.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It serves as a hadith-sciences notice identifying both the transmission route and the narrator’s kunyah, Abū Ismāʿīl.
